notes.title: “Welcome Home” is coming soon on Steam
"Death Code" is coming soon on Steam
The Termination coming soon at Steam
notes.notes: It's a story of deception and redemption. You receive a mysterious invitation to a seven day doomsday journey. An expectant interstellar journey has become a doomsday route to the end. There is only one word difference between "victim" and "perpetrator". When the blade of death is across the lifeline, how can the prisoners who are trapped in the cage escape from the shackles of death? Interstellar space, escape from the secret room, waiting for you to experience!
